blocks.text: HOUSTON— Kevin Durant scored 20 points and became the fifth player in NBA history to reach 33,000 points, helping the Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104 on Wednesday night. Durant shot 7 of 15 from the field and grabbed 10 rebounds. A three-pointer with 46.3 seconds left in the second quarter put him in the 33,000-point club with LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant.
